senses.gloss: छेद m. 1. Fraction; 2. a piece, a cut, a section, अभिनवकरिदंतच्छेदपांडुः कपोलः M.M.i., Megh.i.11, 59, R.xii.100, K.S.i.4; 3. cutting, felling, dividing, अभिज्ञाश्छेदपातानां क्रियंते नंदनद्रुमाः K.S.ii.41, R.xiv.1, Yaj.ii.223, 288; 4. solving, dissipating, removing, as in संशयच्छेद; 5. destruction, cessation; 6. a divisor, the denominator of a fraction (in math.).
छेदन n. 1. Cutting, cutting off, dividing, M.viii.280, 292, 322; 2. a section, a part; 3. destruction, removal.
